title: Illustrative JavaScript loading split
method: A fictional page has 15 KiB of shared interaction code and a 45 KiB calculator. Loading both immediately is 60 KiB; deferring the calculator leaves 15 KiB initially and adds 45 KiB on use. Byte counts do not predict a load-time multiplier.
alt: Illustrative JavaScript loading split. Initial shared controls: 15 KiB; Deferred calculator: 45 KiB. Illustrative inputs.
